params.name: identifier
params.description: The business identifier of the Explanation of Benefit

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of the ExplanationOfBenefit.
The `type` parameter will be ignored if `_profile` query parameter present in the query.

params.name: service-date
params.description:
Date of the service for the EOB. The `service-date` search parameter
simplifies search, since a client doesn't need to know that for inpatient
and outpatient institutional EOB dates they need to search by `billablePeriod.period.start`,
for a pharmacy EOB by `item.servicedDate`, and for a professional and non-clinician
EOB - by `item.servicedPeriod.period.start`.

params.name: _profile
params.description: Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.

params.name: _id
params.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a resource using its logical `id`.
